reason: The missing receipts at month end are a real headache, but I'm not uploading my whole work group export or letting a bot I don't know write into my Google Drive. Maybe I'd forward a few receipts privately to the free version to see, but paying this month, no.
objection: A Telegram bot reading my staff chats and getting access to my Google account. Those chats have guest names, owner payments, bank screenshots. 'Encrypted fingerprints' and 'stays in your Drive' are just words on a page until someone I know vouches for them.
would_change_my_mind: Meeting the Axiom people face to face, or another villa operator in Bali I know telling me they've used it for a few months without problems, and the bot only touching one separate Sheet, not my whole Drive.
